_comment: Sample cards for the demo's Coming Soon shelves (demo mode only; see packages/api/src/services/demoSamples.ts). Nothing here is real: nothing downloads and nothing arrives. offsetHours is relative to each page load. setup-jellyfin.sh adds movie posters from TMDB and writes the result to data/demoSamples.json. Episode samples reuse their library series' artwork.
